Ms. M.S. Bane Agp for the
Respondent-State.

****** Coram: R. D. Dhanuka And M.M.Sathaye Jj.
Date : 13th February, 2023 P.C. :-
1.

On 13th December, 2022 this Court after hearing the learned Counsel for parties,
in presence of the Deputy Collector, Land Acquisition and Rehabilitation Officer,
Kolhapur, allowed the Writ Petition filed by the Petitioners.

In paragraph No. 9 of the order, this Court noted that the impugned order passed by the Deputy Collector (Resettlement), Kolhapur rejected the Application filed by the Petitioners on the ground that the Petitioners have not deposited 65% of the amount of compensation within 45 days from receipt of compensation for the acquire land which order is quashed and set Yugandhara Patil 7-WP-11780-2022.doc aside.

2. This Court also recorded an entitlement of the Petitioners to the alternate land Bhimrao Siddhu Patil And Ors vs The State Of Maharashtra And Ors on 13 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196082260/
1 under Section 16(1)(a) which is not disputed by the Deputy Collector (Resettlement)
by the said order.

entities.text: Bhimrao Siddhu Patil And Ors vs The State Of Maharashtra And Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: This Court accordingly granted liberty to the Respondents to deduct 65% amount of the compensation held payable to the Petitioners and to pay the balance amount of 35% to the Petitioners within four weeks from the date of the said order.
3. This Court permitted Respondents to adjust the said 65% as price for the land that would be allotted to the Petitioners.

This Court recorded statement made by the learned AGP, on instructions that the Petitioners are at liberty to identify the plots which according to the Petitioners are available and can be allotted to the Petitioners.

This Court accordingly directed Deputy Collector (Resettlement) to consider whether those plots are available or not and that whether the Petitioners can be allotted such plots subject to availability and shall communicate the decision within two week thereafter.

This Court made it clear that if the plots identified by the Yugandhara Patil 7-WP-11780-2022.doc Petitioners are not available or in respect of such plots though available, the Petitioners are not eligible for any reasons, the Respondents shall allot any other suitable land as may be available within four weeks thereafter.
This Court accordingly allowed the Petition and placed the matter for reporting compliance.

4. Mr. Patil, learned counsel for the Petitioners states that in pursuance of the said order passed by this Court, Petitioners have already identified the plots and requested Respondents to allot any plot available in the benefited zone.

He invited our attention to the Affidavit-in-Reply dated 6th February,2023 filed by Ashwini Sonawane (Jirange), Deputy Collector (Resettlement), Collector Office, Kolhapur and more particularly averments made in paragraph nos. 2, 3 , 6 and 7 and submitted that Petitioners have not deposited land demand application to Respondents or 65%
of the amount to the Government within 45 days from receipt of compensation for the acquire land
, Petitioners cannot be considered as eligible for getting the land.

5. In our view, though the said order was passed by this Court in Yugandhara Patil 7-WP-11780-2022.doc presence of the Deputy Collector, Land Acquisition and Rehabilitation Officer and after hearing learned AGP who made a statement that this Court would give liberty to the Petitioners to identify the plots which are available and can be allotted to the Petitioners, has filed such affidavit which is totally contradictory to statement made before this Court.
In our view the contempt raised in the Affidavit grossly defies the order passed by this Court on 13 th December 2022.
The Deputy Collector(Resettlement) is bent upon to commit violation of the order passed by this Court with a view to harass the Petitioner which cannot be tolerated by this Court.

6. Issue show cause notice upon Ashwini Sonawane (Jirange), Deputy Collector (Resettlement), Collector Office, Kolhapur, under the provisions of Contempt of Courts Act, 1971, to explain as to why an appropriate action of contempt of Court Bhimrao Siddhu Patil And Ors vs The State Of Maharashtra And Ors on 13 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196082260/
2 shall not be initiated against her for committing a willful disobedience of the order passed by this Court read with Article 215 of the Constitution of India, returnable on 27th February 2023.
7.

Collector Office, Kolhapur is directed to remain present before this Court on the next date without fail.
With a view to give an opportunity, the contemnor is directed to comply with the order on or before the next date.

8. In view of the similar stand taken by the Respondents and more particularly regarding allotment of land within the benefited Zone, under the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, we request learned Advocate General to appear on the next date to look into these similar instances repeatedly occurred in a large number of matters.
